summary: Full E2E test of Trade Settings feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 4/4 pytest passed for /api/bots/{sym} master-sync pad/trim of margin_config and sub_position_tps + min first buy validation. Frontend: login OK, Market tap navigates to /trade-settings/{SYMBOL}, all data-testids present, margin call limit stepper syncs Margin Configuration and Distribution sub-views to exact N rows (verified 8 and 3), edits save via Update with toast, first_buy_amount<10 shows 'Minimum First Buy Amount is $10' toast, coin card tap navigates to /pair/{SYMBOL}.

issues: Binance WebSocket wss://stream.binance.com returns 451 in preview env - live price on coin card falls back to REST /market/stats which is fine, but no live tick updates. Not a code bug (geo-block on egress); acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: BotConfigIn.symbol is required by pydantic but the URL already provides {symbol}. Frontend passes it via spread of `bot` (works), but a direct client (e.g., curl without symbol in body) will 422 instead of using path symbol. Minor - consider making symbol optional in BotConfigIn or overriding it from path in upsert_bot.

TradeSettings.jsx save() spreads full `bot` object including server-only fields (status, position_qty, avg_price, etc.) into POST body; BotConfigIn ignores extras but this is noisy - consider whitelisting fields.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin BTCUSDT bot
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trade Settings page fully functional. All acceptance criteria met. Backend pad/trim logic in upsert_bot (server.py ~L985) correctly enforces margin_call_limit across margin_config & sub_position_tps. Frontend uses syncRows/syncTps in TradeSettings.jsx to keep row counts synced on stepper change.
